lyrics: A crippled sunset & a neon moon
High above the MGM
I'm here lost in thoughts of you
You're far away in a distant land
You're far from faux Elvis & far from faux Venice
White tigers and chapel lights
This bright light city that sparkles & swindles
It's the darkest of places without you tonight
Here in the streets of Paris, Las Vegas
There's no police tape, just cheap souvenirs
No one smokes menthol and nobody's noticed
The river Seine is filling with tears
Pirates & gamblers, players and ramblers
Winners & losers, they all spin the wheel
Across the ocean a city heart broken
By senseless cowards & twisted ideals
There's no showgirls waiting in heaven
It's DJ's and glow sticks and watered-down beer
What did they think, this was Ocean's 11?
I called for the bellboy, let's get outta here
